spec.name: Orange Kitchen Lettuce
spec.description: A freshly harvested butterhead lettuce with a rounded, stepped heart, overlapping ruffled leaves, pale branching ribs and a small cut stem resting at y0.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Lettuce. Recognizable harvested produce matching the exact species; natural stepped silhouette and species-specific skin/leaf detail.
